title: Data Engineer Intern
description: Working on the Cell Team in Palo Alto, building machine learning models that automatically spot defects in battery cells from 3D CT scans, and running them on the team's daily data pipeline.

title: Software Developer Intern
description: Worked on the Expedia iOS and Android apps, moving older screens to a faster, modern architecture. Also built AI agent tools that set up and test app features automatically, making testing much quicker.

title: AI Engineering Intern
description: @ Noah's Ark Lab - Helped build a robotics system where AI models plan out the steps of long household tasks and guide a robot through them. Our team placed top 4 in the 2025 BEHAVIOR Challenge, and we published a paper at an ICLR 2026 workshop.

title: Software Developer Intern
description: Worked on the Contact Center Technology team: helped build a real-time pipeline for call data, made an internal dashboard much faster, rebuilt its interface, and fixed security issues across several apps.

title: Research Intern
description: Built a Blender tool that creates synthetic 3D images for training vision-language AI models, then used that data to improve a model's spatial reasoning. First-authored a paper on the tool, published at ACL 2025.

title: Machine Learning Researcher
description: Studied how people on Reddit talked about the H5N1 bird flu, using machine learning to sort comments by emotion and find the main topics. First-authored a paper on the findings, published in JMIR.
